title: Passport Renewal Status Sync Freshness Gap
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passport:status
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by household
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which owners or feeds have stopped updating passport renewal status records inside the expected time window.
value: Admin workflows fall apart quietly when the feed goes stale, so a freshness check is the easiest way to keep the tracker trustworthy.
implementation: Set the freshness threshold to match how often the admin system or checklist should update.
visualization: Table of household values by hours since last passport renewal status update.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when the records for passport renewal status have gone quiet and might no longer be reliable.
